name: 30-memory-disk-cloud

units.name: model
units.about: Place-neutral value types and codecs: atom, molecule, key codecs, schema and mutation types, protein records, canonical bytes, encryption codecs, keys, wire formats.

units.name: support
units.about: Process edge helpers that every place uses: wall clock, CPU sample, per-request timing and read receipts, task-local user, peer credentials.

units.name: memory
units.about: The warm set (resident core set and core keys), its logical paths and schema-key membership inside disk_pack, the typed core-memory API and post-commit publication staging, memory-first field and key reads, write limits, and the process memory budget.

units.name: disk
units.about: The native disk home: KV traits, encrypting stores, disk_pack commit queue and transactions, run files, merge and cleanup, restore, the mutation log journal, file blobs and their pointer directory, persist lanes, the place-blind logical atom store (tips, counters, molecules, retention, drain, recount, verify, alternate-key and protein rows), its paced workers, and space meters.

units.name: cloud
units.about: Cloud sync and backup: byte backup capture and planner, frozen mutation-log capture, the logical sync stream (export, snapshot, peer, identity), the reqwest byte transport, and the one-cloud-operation guard.

units.name: database
units.about: Schema catalog and the orchestration that spans places: FoldDB, factory, mutation manager (including the sync-stream collector and peer import), query, purge, admin, catalog stores and molecule key contracts, DbOperations facade, change feed, search outbox, sharing rules, mutation admission.

mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/mod.rs: disk; PackRuntime also owns the warm set (core), schema_keys, mutation_log and logical_capture
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/transaction.rs: disk; PendingBatch also carries memory staging (paths, definitions, publications, DeferReservation)
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/transaction/request.rs: disk; scope() also reserves warm paths and waits for the durable commit before return
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/view.rs: disk; install_committed() also publishes clean warm-set state after the disk root
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/read.rs: disk; ReadContext also holds warm-set key reservations
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/transaction/publicatio: memory; also holds the disk-scope predicate active()
mixed_files.db_operations/atom_store/molecules/heade: disk; AtomStore methods that stage headers into core memory
mixed_files.db_operations/conflict_operations/memory: disk; conflict store methods that stage controls into core memory
mixed_files.db_operations/atom_store/schema_keys.rs: memory; AtomStore methods (memory-first key selection, disk miss batch)
mixed_files.schema/types/field/variant/read.rs: memory; methods of the model type FieldVariant
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/mutation_log/mod.rs: disk; journal retained until the cloud receipt
mixed_files.storage/disk_pack/run_restore.rs: disk; consumes the cloud backup codec and snapshot inclusion
disk; also the backup coverage proof
mixed_files.fold_db_core/mutation_manager/logical_ca: database; write-path hook that feeds the cloud sync stream
mixed_files.fold_db_core/mutation_manager/peer_impor: database; write path for cloud-sourced peer facts
mixed_files.crypto/content_key_proof.rs: disk; codec plus a stored home-admission check
mixed_files.db_operations/molecule_key_store.rs: database; key contract that AtomStore and restore proof also need

rule: A file goes to the unit of its dominant effect target. The memory unit holds the warm set and the generic typed-cache API; a store's typed-cache adapter stays with the store that owns the cached object.
